us_au_friction_signal: US NdFeB magnet manufacturing dependent on imports; DoD funding a single US producer
raw_claim_fact: US Department of Defense awarded US$94.1M to E-VAC Magnetics to establish commercial-scale rare-earth permanent-magnet manufacturing in the United States.

us_au_friction_signal: US battery cell production insufficient for demand; upstream cells frequently imported
raw_claim_fact: US-based drone/robot manufacturers often assemble/integrate battery packs domestically, but upstream cells frequently originate abroad; 'US battery manufacturers don't produce enough drone batteries to meet military demand, while Chinese suppliers eclipse domestic ones in both volume and cost.'

us_au_friction_signal: China cost advantage weak/absent below ~100-500 unit volume once shipping/tariff counted
raw_claim_fact: 'For small-batch prototyping (1-100 units), US local sourcing eliminates international shipping delays and extra tariff costs, making overall pricing more competitive for low-volume orders'; the volume crossover to China favor is cited at roughly 100-500+ units.

us_au_friction_signal: US motor-winding equipment base described as decades old, straining under reshoring demand
raw_claim_fact: US motor-manufacturing equipment (coil winders, taping machines, commutator undercutters, banding machines, TIG welders) is described as 'now decades old and operating well past the point where reactive maintenance can keep up' amid a reshoring wave of ~US$1.662 trillion in announced manufacturing commitments (131 companies, 32 states) since Jan 2025.

us_au_friction_signal: ~25% Section 301 duty on robotics components (servo motors HTS 8501.52, power supplies HTS 8504.40, controllers HTS 8537.10)
raw_claim_fact: Section 301 tariffs on China add ~25% on robotics components (servo motors HTS 8501.52, power supplies HTS 8504.40, controllers HTS 8537.10); on a US$60,000 FOB-Shanghai robot this adds ~US$15,000 in duty before freight/insurance/processing fees; importing components separately does not automatically reduce total duty and can increase it if summed component duties exceed the complete-system duty.

us_au_friction_signal: 25% Section 301 duty narrows but does not eliminate Chinese robot price advantage
raw_claim_fact: 'A Chinese arm priced 40% below a Fanuc equivalent still landing 15% cheaper after duty' — i.e. Section 301 tariffs reduce but do not eliminate a Chinese-made industrial robot's price advantage over an equivalent US/Japan-made unit.

us_au_friction_signal: AU sources 65-75% of precision turned metal components from overseas; domestic capacity concentrated in low-volume/prototyping
raw_claim_fact: Australia/Oceania sources an estimated 65-75% of precision turned metal components from overseas; China is the largest single source, supplying ~40-45% of import value in brass/steel parts; domestic AU CNC capacity is concentrated in low-volume technical/prototyping runs rather than production volume.

us_au_friction_signal: 80% of AU fabricators below break-even capacity; 47% report 2025 supply-chain disruption
raw_claim_fact: AU real manufacturing output was down 2.6% YoY to March 2025; AU PMI remained in contraction through 2025 into 2026; 80% of AU fabricators reported operating below break-even capacity benchmark per a 2024 Australian Steel Institute survey; 47% of AU industrial businesses experienced supply-chain disruptions in mid-2025 per Ai Group survey.

us_au_friction_signal: AU robotics-engineer / automation-specialist roles among hardest to fill in 2025-2026
raw_claim_fact: Ai Group's 2026 Industry Outlook found slightly more AU businesses expected workforce shortages to worsen in 2026 than in 2025; robotics engineers, data analysts and industrial automation specialists are among the hardest positions to fill, alongside CNC machinists and industrial engineers.

us_au_friction_signal: AU importer (not overseas factory) bears EESS compliance liability
raw_claim_fact: Under Australia's EESS framework, the Australian importer (not the overseas factory) is the legal 'Responsible Supplier' and carries liability if customs audits find test reports inadequate — 'the penalty and any recall lands on your business, not your supplier's.' ABF increased audits of HS classification and component-level valuation in 2025.

us_au_friction_signal: ChAFTA: >95% of AU tariff lines on Chinese imports at 0%, unlike US Section 301
raw_claim_fact: The China-Australia Free Trade Agreement (ChAFTA) had eliminated tariffs on most electronics/IT products by 1 Jan 2019; over 95% of AU tariff lines for Chinese imports are now at 0%; ABF's Equipment Traceability Management System (ETMS) pre-registration can reduce customs clearance time by 40%+ when completed before shipment.
